admin.rules.add.description: Button that adds a new rule after the others.

admin.rules.add_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível adicionar a regra: {reason}
admin.rules.add_failed.description: Error when adding a rule failed. {reason} is why.

admin.rules.added.defaultMessage: Regra “{rule}” adicionada. O registro de auditoria guarda a alteração.
admin.rules.added.description: Toast after a rule was added, on the page of the new rule. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.cancel.description: Button that closes the confirmation of retiring a rule without retiring it.

admin.rules.change_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível alterar a regra: {reason}
admin.rules.change_failed.description: Error when changing, moving or retiring a rule failed. {reason} is why.

admin.rules.description.defaultMessage: A página Sobre e o formulário de denúncia mostram as regras. Cada regra tem um texto de uma linha e uma dica opcional, escritos uma só vez em qualquer idioma: todos os veem como estão, seja qual for o idioma do app. Uma regra retirada sai das regras em vigor, e as denúncias que a citam a mantêm.

admin.rules.edit.title.description: Heading of the form of a rule's page that changes its text and hint.

admin.rules.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of rules.

admin.rules.empty.description.defaultMessage: Adicione as regras com as quais as pessoas concordam em “Adicionar uma regra”.
admin.rules.empty.description.description: Description of the empty list of the rules in effect.

admin.rules.hint.description: Label of the optional hint of a rule.

admin.rules.list.title.description: Heading and caption of the list of the rules in effect.

admin.rules.move_down.description: Button that moves a rule one place down.

admin.rules.move_down_rule.description: Accessible name of the button that moves a rule down. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.move_up.description: Button that moves a rule one place up.

admin.rules.move_up_rule.description: Accessible name of the button that moves a rule up. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.moved.description: Status after a rule was moved. {rule} is its text; {position} its new place, from 1.

admin.rules.new.title.description: Title of the page of a new rule, and the link to it from the list of rules.

admin.rules.no_text.description: Error of a rule's text left empty or blank.

admin.rules.retire.description: Button that retires a rule, and the confirm button of its dialog.

admin.rules.retire.description.defaultMessage: A regra sai da lista de regras em definitivo. As denúncias que a citam a mantêm.
admin.rules.retire.description.description: Description of the dialog that confirms retiring a rule.

admin.rules.retire.title.description: Question of the dialog that confirms retiring a rule. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.retired.description: Status after a rule was retired. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.save.description: Button that saves a rule's text and hint on its page.

admin.rules.summary.defaultMessage: As regras com as quais as pessoas concordam e que as denúncias citam.
admin.rules.summary.description: Description of the rules screen in the administration menu.

admin.rules.text.description: Label of the text of a rule.

admin.rules.text.description.defaultMessage: Uma linha de no máximo {max} caracteres.
admin.rules.text.description.description: Help of the text of a rule. {max} is the limit.

admin.rules.title.description: Title of the rules screen, in the administration menu and as its heading.

admin.rules.too_long.description: Error of a text or hint of a rule longer than its limit. {max} is the limit.

admin.rules.updated.defaultMessage: “{rule}” salva. O registro de auditoria guarda a alteração.
admin.rules.updated.description: Status after a rule's texts were saved. {rule} is its text.

admin.rules.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the filter of the list of rules: the rules in effect or the retired ones.

admin.rules.filter.active.description: Option of the filter of the list of rules, and the state of a rule in effect on its page.

admin.rules.filter.retired.description: Option of the filter of the list of rules, and the state of a retired rule on its page.

admin.rules.retired.title.description: Heading and caption of the list of the retired rules.

admin.rules.retired.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of retired rules.

admin.rules.retired.empty.description.defaultMessage: Uma regra retirada aparece aqui, e as denúncias que a citam a mantêm.
admin.rules.retired.empty.description.description: Description of the empty list of retired rules.

admin.rules.place.description: Header of the column of a rule's place among the rules in effect, from 1, and the term of it on a rule's page.

admin.rules.revised_at.description: Header of the column of when a rule's text or hint last changed, and the term of it on a rule's page.

admin.rules.retired_at.description: Header of the column of when a rule was retired, and the term of it on a rule's page.

admin.rules.new.description.defaultMessage: A regra é adicionada depois das outras. Você pode movê-la na lista de regras.
admin.rules.new.description.description: Text at the top of the page of a new rule.
